                         PRINT DOCUMENT

                          YOUR     POSSIBLE
  ID  ITEM                CHOICE   CHOICES

  a   Print From Page     0        0 = First Page,
                                   1 = 9999.9.9
  b   Print Through Page  0        0 = Last Page,
                                   1 = 9999.9.9
  c   Print Quantity      1        1 - 99

  d   Paper Handling      2        1 = Cut Paper, Manual Feed
                                   2 = Cut Paper, Automatic Feed
                                   3 = Continuous Paper

  e   Cancel on Error     2        1 = Yes     2 = No
